name: Onii-chan e
source:
Our guy returned to the home that he ran away from three years ago after receiving a telegram that his sister is in dangerous condition. When he got home, he found out that his sister is still sickly, miss him a lot, but otherwise fine. What is going on? Will he run from it with a girl, go crazy, or try to find the truth?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
我们的家伙在收到姐姐处境危险的电报后回到了三年前逃离的家。当他回到家时，他发现妹妹还在生病，很想念他，但其他方面都很好。到底是怎么回事？他会和一个女孩一起逃离，发疯，还是试图找到真相？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]李家欢乐屋[/url]]
